item.title: From Brackets to Enclosures
item.description: A Raspberry Pi 5 snap-fit enclosure puts blender-mcp-bridge through a more demanding agentic test. Claude and Codex successfully construct and verify base-and-lid geometry, while Google Antigravity takes a different path and generates Blender Python instead. The experiment highlights an important distinction: MCP provides the modeling capabilities, but each agent decides how to use them.
